input: matrix is a plain list of plain lists forming a rectangular matrix whose cells are exactly the one-character ASCII strings '0' or '1'. Let r be the number of rows and c their common length, with c = 0 when r = 0. The paired domain has 0 <= r,c <= 4294967295 and mathematical r * c <= 9007199254740991; all arrays must fit both runtimes. Empty matrices and rectangular zero-column matrices are supported. Repeated row aliases are permitted because no input writes occur. Jagged matrices, numeric/boolean cells and concurrent mutation are excluded. Preconditions are not checked at runtime.
return: A nonnegative int equal to the maximum number of cells in an axis-aligned contiguous all-'1' rectangle, or zero when there are no cells or no '1' cells. After each row, heights[column] is the consecutive-'1' run ending at that row in that column. The histogram helper considers every rectangle with that row as its bottom; best retains the maximum across processed rows.
mutation_aliasing: The outer matrix, every row identity and every cell remain unchanged. Repeated row aliases observe no mutation. Only a fresh local height list and local helper stacks are updated. The scalar result carries no input alias, and the Solution instance retains no state.
numeric: The shared bounds are 0 <= r,c <= 4294967295 and r * c <= 9007199254740991. Python integer arithmetic is exact. Heights never exceed r, widths never exceed c, and every helper area is at most r * c; these bounds ensure exact JavaScript Number arithmetic as well. Loop counters and the helper's virtual endpoint are exact. The product bound is a mathematical precondition, not a runtime check.
complexity: O(1 + r * c) time and O(1 + c) auxiliary space under constant-cost bounded-word arithmetic, indexing and amortized stack operations. For nonempty positive-width input, each of r rows updates c heights and invokes an O(c + 1)-time helper. The reusable c-entry height list and at most c live start/height pairs are fully counted; helper stacks are not retained across rows. Empty or zero-column input returns in O(1) time and space.

helpers.name: histogram_area
helpers.contract: Reads nonnegative heights and returns the maximum contiguous histogram area without mutation. Before each right position, stack entries have increasing starts and strictly increasing positive heights; each start is the earliest column supporting that height through right - 1. Taller entries are popped and their earliest starts carried forward. Equal heights keep the existing earlier start. A virtual zero flushes the stack without appending to heights. In this caller, height <= r and width <= c imply every area <= r * c.
helpers.cost: One call per row for positive-width input, none on the early empty branch; each call takes O(c + 1) time and O(c + 1) auxiliary space. Its complete 822-byte UTF-8 definition, from 'def' through the newline after 'return best', is byte-identical in 0084.py and 0085.py and is charged in full in each standalone candidate. Inter-definition blank lines are charged in total source bytes.
